name: agent-unreal
description: Skills for working in Unreal Engine 5.8 from a coding agent: choose the engine system that fits a goal, with a reference per system (Lumen, Nanite, Virtual Shadow Maps, Niagara, Gameplay Ability System, Enhanced Input, AI, Sequencer, networking and more); audit a project's structure, tests and performance practice against Epic's documentation and plan the fixes; build, package and profile a native C++ game; import sprites, meshes and sounds with a guarded importer; and author for UEFN. Includes example scripts that list plugin states, dump the Python surface and build and validate Niagara scenes.
